claims.evidence: MaxQuant summary.txt/mqpar.xml assign the 42 raws to experiments 1-14 (file tag _S<n>_F1..F3 = experiment n, fractions 1-3). Each experiment is one 1:1 SILAC mix of a light and a heavy HEK293 culture of the same transduced line, one given doxycycline and one ddH2O for 4 h (PRIDE sample protocol; Supp Fig S3A, S6D). Each source = one SILAC-labelled culture in one experiment, so no name denotes two physical samples. Experiments 13-14 are not annotated (see limitations).

claims.value: dox channel = SILAC heavy in S1, S3, S5, S8, S9, S11; SILAC light in S2, S4, S6, S7, S10, S12; the other channel untreated
claims.evidence: Explicit design: light = Arg-0/Lys-0, heavy = Arg-10/Lys-8 (PRIDE protocol; summary.txt Labels1 Arg10;Lys8, Multiplicity 2); Supp Fig S3A forward scheme light -dox / heavy +dox (4 h); Supp Methods: phosphosites "present in both forward and reverse (label-swap) experiments"; Supp Fig S6D: both light and heavy lysates contain -dox and +dox samples of every construct. Which experiment is forward or reverse is not stated anywhere, so the orientation is read from the induced transgene itself: median log2 normalized H/L of BRAF peptides aa 380-766 (present in every BRAF construct) S1..S12 = +2.35, -2.67, +1.87, -1.80, +1.15, -1.44, -2.26, +2.32, +2.77, -2.36, +1.56, -1.89 (n = 6-15 peptides each; identity.tsv). Positive = heavy is the induced (+dox) culture. Every construct pair has one forward and one reverse experiment, as the label-swap design requires.

claims.value: S1-S2 AGAP3-BRAF; S3-S4 DLG1-BRAF; S5-S6 TRIM24-BRAF; S7-S8 BRAF wild type; S9-S10 BRAF kinase domain (aa 381-766); S11-S12 BRAF V600E
claims.evidence: Constructs: HEK293 lines transduced with pInducer20 (dox-inducible) GFP, BRAF-WT, BRAF-Kinase, BRAF-V600E, AGAP3-BRAF, DLG1-BRAF, TRIM24-BRAF (Supp Methods; Supp Fig S5/S6 legends) = 7 lines x forward/reverse = 14 experiments. The construct table (figshare 39979488) gives each construct's 5' cloning primer: AGAP3-BRAF, DLG1-BRAF (ATGCCGGTCCGGAAG = DLG1 MPVRK...), TRIM24-BRAF (ATGGAGGTGGCGGTGGAG = TRIM24 MEVAVE...), BRAF-WT and BRAF-V600E (ATGGCGGCGCTGAGC = BRAF MAALS..., full length), BRAF-kinase (ATGGACTTGATTAGAGACC = M + BRAF DLIRD at residue 381). No source states which experiment number holds which construct; the assignment is derived from the transgene products in the deposited MaxQuant tables (identity.tsv, peppos.txt), each pair matched one-to-one: (i) AGAP3 peptides (aa 217-316) change only in S1/S2 (+3.13/-3.63); (ii) DLG1 N-terminal peptides (aa 70-141) only in S3/S4 (+1.69/-1.38); (iii) TRIM24 N-terminal peptides (aa 8-88) only in S5/S6 (+1.81/-2.11); (iv) BRAF N-terminal peptides (aa 147-363, absent from the kinase and fusion constructs) only in S7/S8 (-2.10/+2.22) and S11/S12 (+1.43/-3.07) -> full-length BRAF-WT / BRAF-V600E; (v) S9/S10 carry BRAF aa 380-766 peptides (+2.77/-2.36) but no N-terminal BRAF and no partner peptides -> BRAF-kinase (aa 381-766); (vi) WT vs V600E: Supp Fig S3D gives BRAFV600E the largest set of up-regulated phosphosites (202, vs TRIM24 150, AGAP3 100, DLG1 65, Kinase 8); counts of sites >1.5 log2 up on dox in both experiments of a pair (sitecounts.txt) are S11/S12 149, S5/S6 99, S1/S2 84, S3/S4 51, S9/S10 14, S7/S8 7, i.e. the same rank order with S11/S12 = V600E, and S7/S8 shows almost no ERK activation (MAPK1 Y175 -0.57/+0.69 in dox orientation) as expected for BRAF-WT (Supp Fig S3C: no MAPK kinases among BRAF-WT KSEA hits). The resulting order AGAP3, DLG1, TRIM24, WT, kinase, V600E, (GFP) is also the row order of the construct table. Value strings name the pInducer20 vector (Supp Methods).

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: experiments S13 and S14 (6 raws: 20181213_F1_RM_CHS_0200_TIO2_RVhPH_S13_F1/F2/F3.raw, _S14_F1/F2/F3.raw) are not annotated. By elimination they are the pInducer20-GFP control line (the 7th construct; no BRAF/partner peptide changes, median BRAF aa 380-766 log2 H/L +0.04 / +0.12), but GFP is not in the searched human database, so no transgene peptide shows which SILAC channel received doxycycline, and no source states it. Rows with a not-available treatment would pool unrelated cultures (campaign rule 7). Recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md.

The experiment-number -> construct and label-orientation map is DATA-DERIVED (transgene-product peptides, BRAF N-terminal coverage vs the construct start codons in the construct table, and the rank order of up-regulated phosphosite counts vs Supp Fig S3D), not stated by the authors. Every pair is matched one-to-one, and the resulting order matches the construct-table row order; an author-confirmed key would strengthen it. Weakest link: BRAF-WT (S7/S8) vs BRAF-V600E (S11/S12), which both show full-length BRAF; separated by MAPK activation and phosphosite-response size (Fig S3D V600E 202 sites, the largest), not by a V600E-specific peptide (IGDFGLATV/EK not identified).

Main paper (Mol Cancer Res, not open access) was not retrieved; Methods come from the PRIDE protocols and the AACR figshare Supplementary Materials and Methods / Figures / legends. The figshare item titled "Supplementary Table 1" (KSEA) actually contains the construct/primer table (Table S4 content); the KSEA table was not found.
PRIDE v3 file-list endpoint timed out (project endpoint answered); the file list comes from the ProteomeXchange record, cross-checked with the FTP listing and README.txt (42 raws + 1 MaxQuant zip).

characteristics[passage number] = not available: Supp Methods says HEK293 "were kept in culture for 16 passages until final experiments were performed", which does not give the passage number of the SILAC cultures unambiguously. characteristics[age] / ancestry / individual = not available (Cellosaurus gives Fetus, no population).
Match between runs was on across all 42 raws (including S13/S14); the annotated runs keep the same search parameters, which describe the search they went through.
